result.rationale: The diff explicitly shows `const isTeamAdminOrOwner = (await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...));` — the && requires the caller to be both team admin AND team owner, contradicting the variable's name and the intended OR semantics used in the subsequent authorization check `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee)`. This incorrectly denies admins who are not owners. Correctness defect introduced by this diff.

judged_text: The permission check joins the two role tests with && so the caller must be BOTH a team admin AND a team owner, contradicting the variable name isTeamAdminOrOwner which declares OR semantics. A team ADMIN who is not the team owner is rejected with FORBIDDEN you_do_not_have_permission when adding guests to a teammate's booking — exactly the user class this branch was written to admit; if isTeamAdmin does not include the OWNER role the expression is always false and only organizers/attendees can ever use the feature.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed with `&&`: `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`. This requires the caller to be both a team admin and a team owner, contradicting the variable name and the intended “admin OR owner” permission. As written, a team admin who is not an owner will fail `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee)` and get `FORBIDDEN`, blocking the feature for that role class.
